subject: Cross-border vendor onboarding: VAT reclaim matrix + PO entity routing
messages:
From: Carlos Mendes <carlos@vemco.com>

Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 14:12:00 +0100
Subject: Vendor setup & VAT reclaim questions for Redwood

Hi Logan,

Thanks for the warm intro — I'm Carlos from VemCo Finance. We're starting the vendor onboarding to receive POs from Redwood for the EU logistics work. A few quick items we need to confirm on your side so we can complete our side of the setup: 

- Which Redwood legal entity will be issuing POs for services in Germany & the Netherlands? We need the exact legal name and VAT number to validate tax treatment.
- Does Redwood require VAT registration evidence from non-EU suppliers for reverse-charge, or do you accept a supplier declaration plus commercial invoice in your PO system?
- For VAT reclaim: do you allow us to submit invoices post-payment for reclaim against Redwood's VAT when services are cross-charged?
- Preferred invoice format? Our AP system exports XML/UBL — will that work, or do you need PDF + structured XML?

I've attached our standard vendor form and a sample invoice. Happy to hop on a short call if easier.

Best,
Carlos
Finance Manager
VemCo Logistics

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 15:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Vendor setup & VAT reclaim questions for Redwood

Carlos — thanks for the note and the files. Looping in Laura (AP lead) and Ben (tax/PO routing) to confirm specifics. Below are quick answers and next steps: 

1) Redwood issuing entity: For EU logistics work we typically issue POs from "Redwood Inference Ltd" (UK) or our EU-managed entity "Redwood Inference GmbH" depending on the country of performance. For Germany & NL POs we prefer Redwood Inference GmbH — VAT: DE999999999 — will confirm with legal and send exact registration copy by end of day.

2) Evidence for reverse-charge: We accept supplier VAT registration (if the supplier has an EU VAT) OR a signed supplier VAT residency declaration + commercial invoice that shows the service description and identifies reverse-charge. We do NOT require fiscal representative documents for routine B2B services, but that can be discussed case-by-case.

3) VAT reclaim workflow: If Redwood is being invoiced gross and VemCo needs to reclaim, we can accept post-payment invoices and coordinate reclaim credits under a contractual credit note process (requires PO line matching and transaction reference). Ben — can you confirm any limits or preferred timing for reclaim credits?

4) Invoice format: PDF invoice is required for the AP record, XML/UBL is strongly preferred for automated ingestion (your sample XML looks fine). Please ensure invoice includes VAT numbers for both parties and the PO number in a dedicated field.

Next steps: Ben to provide the PO-splitting rules (how we map multi-entity POs when services cross countries) and Laura to send the vendor activation checklist. Carlos — if you can fill the attached vendor form and return, we'll fast-track activation.

Thanks,
Logan
Sr. Procurement Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Vendor setup & VAT reclaim questions for Redwood

Adding the PO-entity & VAT handling details so Carlos has everything in one place. TL;DR: mapping rules + required invoice fields.

PO routing and entity-split rules (applies when Redwood engages a vendor across multiple countries):
- If services are performed in-country (e.g., Germany logistics), issue PO from Redwood Inference GmbH (DE999999999).
- If services are delivered from non-EU team to EU customer-facing work, use Redwood Inference Ltd (UK) and apply reverse-charge where applicable.
- For multi-leg services, we create a single PO with line-level entity tags; AP will split payment across entities during settlement. To do this we need: 1) PO number, 2) line-level GL/entity tag on the invoice, 3) VAT numbers for supplier and the Redwood entity behind each line.

Required invoice data fields for automated processing: 
- PO number (exact match)
- Supplier VAT or tax id
- Redwood legal entity name + Redwood VAT on each relevant line
- Line-level net and VAT amounts and currency
- Invoice UUID/reference and payment instructions (IBAN/SWIFT)

VAT reclaim & credits:
- If VemCo pays gross and requests reclaim, we require the original invoice plus proof of payment and a short reclaim form (we'll supply a template). Credits to VemCo are issued via a credit note referencing the original invoice; timing is subject to our monthly AP cycle (30–45 days after claim approval).

I'll attach the internal PO-split mapping template to the Drive folder. Carlos — once we have your filled vendor form and sample XML we can stage a test invoice ingestion.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Expense & AP Lead
Redwood Inference
